svg.title: Two colors, but never eight matching corners
svg.desc: A cube-shaped grid of tiny cells, each painted blue (color 1) or gold (color 0). Two flat layers of an 11 by 11 by 11 grid, Layer 0 and Layer 2, are shown side by side; Layer 1 between them is skipped. On the right, a small sketch of a rectangular box whose eight corners are all blue is marked as forbidden. The box can stretch across layers that are not next to each other, such as Layer 0 and Layer 2. The proof result: colorings exist that avoid any such box in both grid sizes 11 by 11 by 11 and 16 by 16 by 16.
